articles.title: The Ocean’s Spookiest Sound Wasn’t a Monster — It Was a Giant Ice Cube!
articles.summary: In 1997, scientists heard a super-loud, low growl they called “the Bloop.” It traveled over 3,100 miles across the Pacific! Many thought it was a huge sea monster, but after 8 years, they found out it was actually a giant piece of ice breaking off Antarctica.

articles.title: Bob Odenkirk Stars in a Wacky Remake of the “Worst Movie Ever” — for Charity!
articles.summary: The famously bad movie “The Room” is getting a silly remake called “The Room Returns.” Bob Odenkirk plays the main character, Johnny. It was filmed in just one day with no budget, and all the money from the premiere goes to charity.

articles.title: Fox Signs YouTube Stars to Make Cool New Shows — And Lets Them Do Whatever They Want!
articles.summary: Fox is teaming up with seven popular online creators, like Josh Richards and Emelia Hartford, to make new shows. The best part? Fox gives them money but doesn’t tell them what to do. The creators keep control of their ideas.
